headline: BioArctic Notes FDA Approval of Subcutaneous Leqembi Autoinjector
summary: BioArctic highlighted that the US FDA approved the Leqembi Iqlik subcutaneous autoinjector in July for weekly initiation treatment of Alzheimer's patients, forming part of its interim report.
why: BioArctic is a biopharmaceutical company focused on disease-modifying treatments for neurodegenerative disorders, where regulatory approvals are critical value drivers.

impacts.name: BioArctic
impacts.why: The company reported regulatory approval of its treatment in major markets during its interim period.
